marketProjection.note: Additive projection for Mission Control v2. Campaigns optimize editorial throughput while preserving Publisher scoring, execution packet compatibility, and hidden Work Items.

automationLevels.label: Autonomous
automationLevels.description: EOS can eventually prepare this work without new field input, with deterministic QA before publishing.

automationLevels.label: Review Required
automationLevels.description: EOS can prepare or structure the work, but a human editor must approve judgments or evidence.

automationLevels.label: Human Only
automationLevels.description: The work requires human capture, review, relationship judgment, or external evidence not yet available to automation.

executionProviders.label: Manual
executionProviders.description: A human uses the execution packet as a checklist and updates EOS externally.

executionProviders.label: Codex
executionProviders.description: A future execution provider can consume the packet and return work for review.

queues.label: Editorial Queue
queues.purpose: Improve existing metros through Publisher, Compass, Handbook, and Knowledge Graph work.

queues.label: Expansion Queue
queues.purpose: Manage future metros as multi-stage projects instead of single tasks.

queues.label: Field Mode Queue
queues.purpose: Summarize photography coverage and route work into Field Mode.

queues.label: Review Queue
queues.purpose: Show work returned by future autonomous execution providers.

operatingLanes.label: Engineering

operatingLanes.label: Execution / Field Mode

operatingLanes.label: Editorial
operatingLanes.description: Commercial judgment, building profiles, handbook guidance, and public editorial depth.

operatingLanes.label: QA
operatingLanes.description: Deterministic checks, recommendation validation, review approval, and publishing readiness.

executionHandoff.label: Engineering
executionHandoff.description: Prepare source files, schema, generated data, or implementation scope.

executionHandoff.label: Execution / Field Mode
executionHandoff.description: Execute the work manually, through Field Mode, or through a future provider.

executionHandoff.label: QA
executionHandoff.description: Run deterministic validation and return exceptions to review.

executionHandoff.label: Publish
executionHandoff.description: Regenerate snapshots/build and publish through the existing deployment workflow.

healthModel.note: Overall Editorial Health is additive and separate from Publisher score. Future signals can be added by appending a scored signal and weight.

investmentModel.note: Investment Score answers whether Rofo should invest next. External Search Console, analytics, and broker-performance signals are not connected in v2.2.

expansionWorkflow.note: Expansion metros are projects with stage progress, not single queue tasks.

planningModel.note: EOS v2.2.4 recommends coherent missions generated from measurable opportunities. Raw opportunities remain available in inventory.
